articles.title: Robot Runs Half-Marathon Faster Than Any Human — and It's Just Getting Started
articles.summary: A humanoid robot smashed the human half-marathon record by almost 7 minutes. In just one year, robot race times dropped by more than two-thirds. AI is teaching them to run, think, and maybe even build cars.

articles.title: When It's Too Hot, Animals Get Confused, Cranky, and Forgetful
articles.summary: Heat waves don't just make you sweaty — they mess with animal brains. Birds can't solve puzzles, dogs bite more, and bees forget which flowers to visit. Scientists worry this could hurt whole ecosystems as the planet warms.

articles.title: Is There a Hidden Giant Planet in Our Solar System? New Clues Say Maybe Not
articles.summary: For years, scientists thought a big, unseen planet was tugging on icy objects far beyond Neptune. But a newly found space rock has a stable orbit, which makes the hidden-planet idea harder to believe. The mystery isn't solved yet.
